title: 识别提交时只刷新当前可见的藏品分页

diagnosis.confirmed: CompactAssistant.refresh refreshed all four inventory tabs on every accepted observation, even with tools/parts/shop hidden. Profile attributed repeat public packet reads/parsing to those hidden tabs. Regression reproduced calls[1,1,1,1] instead of[1,0,0,0].
diagnosis.profile_scope: cProfile run locates the work but its233-320ms cache-return GUI times include profiler overhead and are not performance acceptance.
diagnosis.other_costs: Latest-frame buffering/settling and polling remain153-271ms in these return samples. Capture and map rendering still contribute. No settling/recognition thresholds changed.

implementation: Refresh current inventory tab and shared resource/navigation header; hidden tab models still receive all normal observations through the existing run-state path.
Tab change refreshes the newly selected page from current state/source before the next Paint; normal window reopening retains its existing on_show refresh.

Parts view reloads its exchange source before refresh; independently visible inventory/shop source cards continue refreshing. Search, reading state and source-unavailable clearing use existing panel logic.
OCR, complete-result caches, capture, settling, sampling interval and chronological observation merge are unchanged.

method.windows: Two alternating baseline/candidate runs, each8 switches,2052x1128 WGC to checked visible Qt Paint. Baseline restores only player_compact.py from3c763c4bd.
method.endpoint: Same previously established harness: widget.update requested after sample acceptance if unchanged facts would otherwise skip Paint. This is actual repaint after accepted current source, not proof that old retained facts were incorrect.
method.context: One isolated run per replay, confirmed settings evolve normally. Index0 includes model initialization; index2 first map return misses the exact cache after new settings confirmation, and stays in all-return totals.
method.ui_measurement: Second paired round uses identical lightweight wall-clock wrappers for worker completion, sample delivery and sample_received. Both original raw traces retained. First baseline round had no wrapper; first candidate had it, so that pair alone is not used for UI attribution.
method.limits: Image source and assistant share a Qt process; no live-game animation/contention, no broad accuracy or p95 claim.

rejected_or_limited_evidence: Initial regression run had3 expected failures on original code; imported fixture class also collected its21 tests. Final test module imports fixture as a module to avoid duplicate test discovery.

Initial combined55-test offscreen run failed one existing reference-window assertion:800px virtual screen clamps850px requested width to776px. Baseline reproduced the identical failure. The unchanged6-test reference module passes using native Windows; remaining49 tests pass offscreen.
First-entry inventory candidate1675/1698ms still exceeds500ms; initial map including model start2996/3155ms. No first-entry success claimed.
First map return after configuration confirmation remains836/842ms. The10/10 sub500ms finding applies to exact cached returns, not all12 return operations.

review.spec: Seven targeted scenarios cover no hidden-tab work, latest tool holdings on switch with search retained, unavailable parts sources cleared on switch, current part count/exchange source, shop opening without a new sample, and both visible source-card paths. Existing sampling timeline and native back/forward/reading state checks pass.
review.code: Existing refresh entry chooses visible work; currentChanged connects after all popup members exist. Reuses existing state/source validation at each newly visible entry; no source checks removed, no speculative fallback, retry, broad catch or new abstraction. No low-probability defensive policy changed.
review.publication: One product module, one new test module, aggregate receipt and continuation/index only. Raw game/source frames, observations, private settings/state and unrelated AGENTS/.agents/video excluded.

remaining: Stable universal sub500ms remains unaccepted. First-entry pages, changing pixels, new configuration and live-game load still require work.
Further separate intentional120ms frame-settling cost from100ms polling and capture; do not remove stabilization without transition/short-page correctness evidence.
Map rendering, reader fork tails and hidden technical preview updates remain separate potential GUI costs, not proven fixed by this batch.
